CREATE VIEW container_depletion_rank_view AS
SELECT 
    c.containregistry,
    c.containmodel,
    c.volliters,
    c.masskg,
    c.coolkind,
    c.coolmass,
    c.coolremainpct,
    c.refilllatest,
    ROUND(CAST((100 - c.coolremainpct) / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_DATE - c.refilllatest)) / 86400, 0) AS numeric), 4) AS coolant_depletion_rate,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (100 - c.coolremainpct) / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_DATE - c.refilllatest)) / 86400, 0) DESC) AS depletion_rank,
    CASE 
        WHEN (100 - c.coolremainpct) / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_DATE - c.refilllatest)) / 86400, 0) > 1 AND c.coolremainpct < 30 THEN 'Coolant Critical'
        ELSE 'Normal'
    END AS depletion_status
FROM container c;
